answer: Step one: the network plants honeypot tasks whose correct answer is known and whose tempting wrong answer is also known. Step two: any submission matching the wrong answer is scored 0 and flagged, with a cap of one submission per identity per epoch so a farm cannot retry its way out. Because each submission carries a fresh nonce, resending the same text is a new countable event. Result: a falcon that dives at every task hits the trap once and loses the epoch, and 500 clones on one basalt script fail on the same task, leaving a single thread to pull.
